_note: Single ad config. Leave IDs empty to show nothing. Web = Google AdSense; Android app = AdMob (@capacitor-community/admob). 'android' = LIVE IDs used by release builds. 'androidDebug' = Google's public TEST IDs; capacitor/copy-www.js writes them into the debug build only. Add your phone's AdMob test-device ID (shown in logcat as 'Use RequestConfiguration...setTestDeviceIds') to android.testingDevices so you never see or click your own live ads, even in the release build.
